items.prompt:
Heat flows from the ____ object to the ____ object.
A) hotter; cooler
B) cooler; hotter
C) bigger; smaller
D) lighter; heavier

steps: Heat flows from hotter to cooler.

items.prompt:
Thermal equilibrium is when two objects
A) reach the same temperature
B) have very different temperatures
C) stop existing
D) freeze

A hot drink cools to room temperature because heat flows
A) from the drink to the cooler room
B) from the room into the drink
C) in no direction
D) from cold to hot
items.answer: A) from the drink to the cooler room

steps: Heat flows to the cooler surroundings.

items.prompt:
A hot spoon placed in cool water will
A) cool down while the water warms
B) warm up while the water cools
C) stay the same
D) freeze the water
items.answer: A) cool down while the water warms

steps: Heat flows from spoon to water.

items.prompt:
A cold soda on a warm table will
A) warm up
B) cool down more
C) stay the same forever
D) freeze the table

steps: Heat flows into the cold soda.

items.prompt:
Heat stops flowing between two objects when they
A) reach the same temperature
B) are far apart
C) are different colors
D) are the same size

steps: Equal temperature stops net heat flow.

items.prompt:
Heat never flows on its own from a cold object to a hot one because
A) heat naturally flows only from hotter to cooler until they match
B) cold objects have no energy
C) heat is destroyed
D) temperature does not matter
items.answer: A) heat naturally flows only from hotter to cooler until they match

steps: Natural flow is hot to cold.

items.prompt:
Mixing hot and cold water results in
A) a single in-between temperature (thermal equilibrium)
B) the water staying at two temperatures
C) the cold water getting colder
D) no change
items.answer: A) a single in-between temperature (thermal equilibrium)
